    // SUITE_NATIVE_ABI_1: generated by vendor/libraw-suite/prepare.mjs.
    private suiteInputLength = 0;

    private static suiteNative() {
        const mod = LibRaw.module as unknown as {
            HEAPU8: Uint8Array;
            _malloc(size: number): number;
            _free(ptr: number): void;
            _suite_libraw_abi_version?: () => number;
            _suite_libraw_plan_full_geometry(p: number, n: number, mb: number, w: number, h: number): number;
            _suite_libraw_set_max_raw_memory_mb(p: number, mb: number): number;
            _suite_libraw_get_processed_format(p: number, w: number, h: number, c: number, b: number): number;
        };
        if (!mod || mod._suite_libraw_abi_version?.() !== 1 ||
            typeof mod._suite_libraw_plan_full_geometry !== "function" ||
            typeof mod._suite_libraw_set_max_raw_memory_mb !== "function" ||
            typeof mod._suite_libraw_get_processed_format !== "function")
            throw new Error("SUITE native ABI 1 is not installed");
        return mod;
    }

    static suiteABIVersion(): number {
        return LibRaw.suiteNative()._suite_libraw_abi_version!();
    }

    private suiteBudget(mb: number): void {
        if (!Number.isInteger(mb) || mb < 1 || mb > 512)
            throw new RangeError("RAW memory budget must be 1..512 MiB");
        if (this._status !== "ready" || !this.lr)
            throw new Error("RAW decoder is not ready");
    }

    setMaxRawMemoryMB(mb: number): void {
        this.suiteBudget(mb);
        const code = LibRaw.suiteNative()._suite_libraw_set_max_raw_memory_mb(this.lr, mb);
        if (code !== 0) throw new LibRawError(code, "Cannot set RAW memory budget");
    }

    planFullGeometry(mb: number): { width: number; height: number } {
        this.suiteBudget(mb);
        if (!this.inputPtr || !this.suiteInputLength) throw new Error("RAW input is not open");
        const mod = LibRaw.suiteNative();
        const out = mod._malloc(8);
        if (!out) throw new Error("Geometry result allocation failed");
        try {
            const code = mod._suite_libraw_plan_full_geometry(this.inputPtr, this.suiteInputLength, mb, out, out + 4);
            if (code !== 0) throw new LibRawError(code, "RAW full geometry planning failed");
            const view = new DataView(mod.HEAPU8.buffer);
            return { width: view.getInt32(out, true), height: view.getInt32(out + 4, true) };
        } finally { mod._free(out); }
    }

    getProcessedFormat(): { width: number; height: number; colors: number; bits: number } {
        this.suiteBudget(1);
        const mod = LibRaw.suiteNative();
        const out = mod._malloc(16);
        if (!out) throw new Error("Format result allocation failed");
        try {
            const code = mod._suite_libraw_get_processed_format(this.lr, out, out + 4, out + 8, out + 12);
            if (code !== 0) throw new LibRawError(code, "RAW processed format is unavailable");
            const view = new DataView(mod.HEAPU8.buffer);
            return { width: view.getInt32(out, true), height: view.getInt32(out + 4, true),
                colors: view.getInt32(out + 8, true), bits: view.getInt32(out + 12, true) };
        } finally { mod._free(out); }
    }
